label: Goa
tagline: Beaches, Portuguese churches and seafood shacks.

hotels.name: Jungle Hostel Goa
hotels.note: Backpacker hostel with a pool and garden; five minutes from Anjuna beach.

hotels.name: Cuba Retreat
hotels.note: Simple huts and rooms on a quiet stretch with a good breakfast cafe.

hotels.name: The Fern Kadamba
hotels.note: Reliable chain hotel near Panaji; handy base if you plan to drive around.

hotels.name: Resort Rio
hotels.note: Large resort with two pools and in-house water sports desk.

hotels.name: Taj Exotica Resort & Spa
hotels.note: Sprawling beachfront resort with a spa and a nine-hole golf course.

hotels.name: W Goa
hotels.note: Cliffside designer hotel above Vagator beach with a lively bar scene.

hotels.name: Casa Britona
hotels.note: Restored riverside Portuguese villa, calm and full of character.

things_to_do.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
things_to_do.note: UNESCO-listed 16th-century church holding the relics of St Francis Xavier.

things_to_do.name: Fort Aguada and lighthouse
things_to_do.note: 17th-century Portuguese fort with the best sweeping sea views in North Goa.

things_to_do.name: Palolem Beach
things_to_do.note: Crescent of calm water with kayaks and beach huts; go on a weekday.

things_to_do.name: Anjuna flea market
things_to_do.note: Seasonal Wednesday market for clothes, jewellery and street food.

things_to_do.name: Dudhsagar Falls day trip
things_to_do.note: Four-tier waterfall reached by forest jeep; book a slot before you go.

eateries.name: Fisherman's Wharf
eateries.must_try: Goan fish curry rice and prawn balchao
eateries.note: Riverside seafood restaurant with live music most evenings.

eateries.name: Gunpowder
eateries.note: South Indian and Goan menu in a leafy courtyard; booking helps.

eateries.name: Vinayak Family Restaurant
eateries.must_try: Fish thali and kingfish rava fry
eateries.note: Local favourite for an unfussy, very fresh fish thali.

eateries.name: Britto's
eateries.must_try: Prawn curry rice with your feet in the sand
eateries.note: Long-standing beach shack; lively in season, quiet off it.
